decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposal contained in the application and the plans submitted and numbered Noise Assessment, Planning Statement, Received 9 February 2011 therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 3 - The premises shall not be open to customers outside the hours of 9.00am to 8.00pm Monday to Friday, 9.00am to 6.00pm on Saturdays and 11.00am to 5.00pm on Sundays, unless prior written approval is obtained from the Local Planning Authority. Deliveries to the premises shall also be within these times.

Condition : 4 - The development hereby permitted shall only be used for the retail sales of automobile accessories, bicycles and bicycle accessories, and other related products and for no other purpose (including any other purpose in class A1 of the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987 or any Order revoking or enacting that Order.
Condition : 5 - Ancillary fitting of vehicles shall not include tyre or exhaust fitting or any industrial activity outside Class B1 of the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987.
description: Variation of Condition 5 of planning permission 00248/512-518/P25 for the use of ground floor for activities falling within class (A1) retail use dated 13/10/2004 to alter Sunday opening hours from 10.00am-4.00pm to 11.00am-5.00pm.
